You started the day by checking the weather in Canberra, which was sunny with a high of 30°C. Your calendar showed a team standup at 9:30 AM, a team lunch at 12:30 PM, and sprint planning at 3:00 PM, with nothing scheduled afterwards.

In the afternoon, you took a fifteen-minute walk around the block after lunch and asked me to note that you started the book Hannah lent you, wanting to finish chapter three tonight. I set a reminder for Thursday at 1:00 PM to post Hannah’s Christmas present. When we discussed upgrading the logging library, I confirmed it is already in your Platform Cleanup note so no duplicate was added. You also asked what you can make with halloumi and capsicum, so I shared a tray bake recipe to serve over rice.

To wrap up, you shared that you’re grateful for the nice weather and Hannah lending you the book. It’s been a warm day well spent on work and personal tasks.
